newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai New Asia to list 25 million A shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai New Asia to list 25 million A shares.

text.p: Hotel operator Shanghai New Asia (Group) will list 25 million domestic A shares on Friday on the Shanghai stock exchange, a company statement said on Tuesday.

The statement said the 25 million shares, accounting for 7.05 percent of the firm's total share capital, included 19 million A shares launched at 4.9 yuan per share on September 13 this year, and six million shares issued to employees in 1993.
The issue has raised a net total of 90.15 million yuan and the money will be invested in a new hotel, a foodstuffs factory and a hotel management company, it said.
The remaining six million staff shares would not be listed until October 1999, the statement added.
After this year's issue, Shanghai New Asia would have a total of 354.64 million shares including 100 million foreign currency B shares listed on the Shanghai exchange, it said.
Shanghai New Asia, whose main business is operating hotels in Shanghai, posted a 43.9 million yuan net profit in the first half of 1996, up from 40.4 million yuan a yerar earlier.
